brief: Plain front-gabled red barn in horizontal drop siding with crisp white corner boards and verge trim, and a bright red ribbed-metal roof whose rear slope sweeps down lower over a lean-to aisle (saltbox profile). A big white-outlined ranch brand is painted high on the gable; three small white-framed stall windows low on the wall. A row of pale post-rock limestone fence posts stands in front along the field edge.
